== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
=== Stellar Data ===
'''Soror''' has a solitary primary star.
* It is an orange main sequence.

{{MonostellarSystem
|name           = Soror
|primary        = K1 V 
|PrimaryName    = Primary
|PrimaryNotes   = 
}}

The star is relatively young, with an approximate age of [[Year|3 billion years]].

=== System Data ===
The worlds of the [[system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:
* The [[mainworld]].
* x9 secondary [[world|rocky worlds]].
* x4 [[gas giant]]s, named ''Claire'', ''Dominique'', ''Julia'', and ''Jeanne''.
** ''Claire'' is a [[Gas Giant|hot gas giant]] orbiting very close to the star.

=== Mainworld Data ===

==== [[Planetary Size|Mainworld Size]] (S) ====
{{WorldSize|name= Soror|Size= 6}}

==== [[Atmosphere|Mainworld Atmosphere]] (A) ====
{{WorldAtmo|name= Soror|Atmosphere= 5}}
* It experiences [[Celsius|relatively high temperatures]].

==== [[Hydrosphere|Mainworld Hydrosphere]] (H) ====
{{WorldHydro|name= Soror|Hydrosphere= 9}}

==== Satellites ====
'''Soror''' retains a single [[Natural Satellite|vacuum moon]] named ''Frere''.
* It orbits once every few days.

[[File:Alien Moon 02c-1.jpg|600 px]]

==== Mainworld Geography and Topography ====
No centrally held map of the world exists within [[Argushiigi Admegulasha Bilanidin|AAB]] [[Library Data]] records.

Soror is a world with a vast world-ocean, with a single main continent and some co-located archipelagoes. It is also in the midst of an ice age, with large ice caps extending down to the 45th latitude. The massive hydrographic percentage, combined with the thin atmosphere, results in a high global humidity and near permanent mist and cloud layers.

[[File:Blank World Map Watery.png|500 px]] <br> (''Blank map, predominantly watery world''.)

==== Native Lifeforms ====
Exotic aquatic [[Lifeform|native life]] occupying a few specialist ecological niches. Its metabolic functions help drive the process of atmospheric renewal.
* Scientists have determined that most indigenous life is concentrated around undersea thermal vents.

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
[[File:Comp-Prog-Dav-R-Deitrick-Starter-Trav-Page-16 16-July-2018a.jpg|right]]
'''Soror''' was settled at or about [[935]] by a wave of colonists from [[Euxene (world)|Euxene]], following the colonization of [[Myrthe (world)|Myrthe]].

The Soror colonists were an opportunistic group of individualists, who negotiated a land-rush contract with the government of [[Euxene (world)|Euxene]], given on the basis of long-range scans of the system and the designated [[mainworld]] specifically. Over 50 spacecraft departed at the same time from [[Euxene (world)|Euxene]], with the only rules being that a successful craft landing on the solid surface of Soror would lay claim to [[Kilometer|100 km]] radius of land. An independent black-box devices provided by [[Euxene (world)|Euxene]] would verify each landing. Some larger vessels, of course, deployed secondary craft to exploit the rules. Others left early without black-boxes, but with heavy weaponry.

The bulk of the colonists arrived within a 48 hour span. The earliest arrivals – later referred to as ''The Earliers'' – were waiting for them, and attempted to kill, capture, and extort possession of the black-box rights from all who landed. The contract-abiding colonists were more heavily-armed than the Earliers had expected and were also more suspicious. The initial clashes were epic, with large losses on both sides. The Earliers managed to extort rights from four landing teams, concentrated on the eastern escarpment of the main Continent, but were otherwise contained. The remaining colonists surrounded those sites, expanding along the coast and into the coastal mountains. Each landing site founded its own settlement, and promptly entrenched themselves. At that point, [[Euxene (world)|Euxene]] validated the black-box positions, mapped the officially recognized settlements, resolved any overlaps, and washed their hands of the situation.

The Sororans followed the Euxene Colonization Agreement, and sent Departmental Parties to the Parliament. The presence of heavily-armed MP staffs resulted in very polite discussions in most cases, with a few notably violent and bloody clashes. The losing Departments eventually provided replacement staffs that were both more heavily-armed and more polite. The result was a standard year of internal bickering and the formation of political blocs as the settlements themselves attempted to establish a status quo.

Over time, the culture has evolved to more of a cooperative-yet-competitive nature. There are now established allied regions, which contain settlements. There are regional and local rivalries of various intensities. Most if not all citizens and visitors are armed with effective weaponry. Weapons of mass-destruction are the only things that are widely agreed against. Most settlements take extensive steps to make it difficult for young adults to create excuses for gun fights and private wars, and those steps have been proven to be needed. Nonetheless, the presence of weapons is an ingrained part of the culture and is enshrined in the Constitution...in expansive language.

=== [[Starport|World Starport]] (St) ===
{{Starport|name= Soror|Starport= B}}

The Soror [[Highport]] was built approximately 50 years ago with funds from the [[Euxene (world)|Euxene]] government. Now, it is run by an equal mix of [[Euxene (world)|Euxene]] and Soror personnel.

Downports have been built on a regional level. The largest downport is the Early Downport on the eastern coast.
* Discussions are still ongoing as to where to site a global Downport.

=== [[Population|World Population]] (P) ===
{{WorldPop|name= Soror|multiplier= 1|Population= 7}}
* About 95% of the population (roughly 9.5 million individuals) is made up of [[Solomani]] humans.
* Around 5% of the population (less than 500,000 individuals) consists of [[Aslan]].

[[File:Aslan Leader Ship T Bradstreet 2.jpg|300 px|right]]

==== Linguistic Topography ====
The most commonly heard [[language]]s are:
* [[Euxene French (language)|Euxene French]], a [[Terran]] language principally spoken in the [[Euxene Cluster]].
* [[Rim Anglic]], a dialect of [[Anglic]] and the principal language of the [[Solomani Confederation|Confederation]].
* [[Trokh]], the principal language of the [[Aslan]].

=== [[Technology Level|World Technology Level]] (T) ===
{{WorldTech|name= Soror|WorldTech= B}}

=== [[Government|World Government]] (G) ===
{{WorldGov|name= Soror|Government= 2}}

The Soror Parliament is populated by a trio of MPs from each settlement, each elected locally by 6 year terms, every 2 years.

==== World Military ====
Virtually the entire citizenry is armed. Most regions have one or two craft that can provide for world-level security.

=== [[Law Level|World Law]] (L) ===
{{WorldLaw|name= Soror|Law= 1}}

Sororans are armed and well practiced with their arms. Most have never fired in anger, but many have been part of a "dispute" at some point or another. Those who choose to be a part of law enforcement are well-respected, soft-spoken, and very well-equipped.

=== Trade Data ===
* [[Importance Extension|Importance]]: 2 (ordinary)

=== World Economy ===
There are several local industries based on the strengths of the original colonists for each settlement and the local mineral deposits. Some bespoke bioengineered cattle have been imported from [[Ivraie (world)|Ivraie]] along with some altered ivraie grasses and their supporting microbial and [[insectoid]] biome.

The world's principal industries are ore mining, metals, agriculture, cattle farming, computer engineering, and virtual world modeling. Major exports include metal ingots, food stuffs, VR simulations.

* [[Resource]]s:                       9 (moderate)
* [[Labor]]:                           6 (millions)
* [[Infrastructure]]:                  7 (generally available)
* [[Efficiency]]:                      +1 (average)

=== World Culture ===
Several regional universities have been built, and there are commonly at least one technical college per settlement. The world information net is well established, albeit not at the level of most Imperial or even Solomani standards. Vacation trips are usually planned to the higher mountain peak-towns that extend above the cloud layers. Some peak-towns have gone so far as to bore residential tunnels, but they are only now beginning to see some tourist trade from the core Republic worlds.

* [[Homogeneity|Heterogenity]]:        C (fragmented)
* [[Acceptance]]:                      9 (friendly)
* [[Strangeness]]:                     5 (distinct)
* [[Symbol]]s:                         8 (somewhat abstract)

==== World Timeline ====
Major events that have affected this world and the wider region that it lies within:

* [[-9235]]: far to [[coreward]], the [[Vilani]] discover [[jump drive]] technology. Over the centuries pioneers and settlers gradually spread across [[Charted Space]].
* [[-4045]] to [[-2204]]: the [[First Imperium|Ziru Sirka]] controls vast territories.
* [[-2431]]: [[Terran]]s discover [[jump drive]] technology.
* [[-2404]] to [[-2215]]: the [[Interstellar Wars]]. The young [[Terran Confederation]] battles against the ancient [[Vilani]] [[First Imperium|Ziru Sirka]].
* [[-2204]] to [[-1776]]: the [[Rule of Man]] administers the former [[First Imperium|Ziru Sirka]].
* [[-1999]]: the [[Aslan]] gain [[jump drive]] technology.
* [[-1862]] to [[-1110]]: the [[Terran Mercantile Community]] is active within the region.
* [[-1776]] to [[0]]: the [[Long Night]].
* [[-1118]] to [[380]]: the [[Aslan Border Wars]].
* [[-1110]] to [[588]]: the [[Terran Mercantile Community]] gradually becomes the [[Old Earth Union]], shrinking to control the region around [[Terra]].
* [[0|The Year 0]]: to [[coreward]], the [[Third Imperium]] is founded.
* [[300]]-[[420]]: the {{Imperial}} [[First Survey]] charts the system.
* [[380]]: the [[Peace of Ftahalr]] ends the ongoing [[Aslan Border Wars]] and establishes understandings regarding human and [[Aslan]] influence. 
* [[588]]: the [[Old Earth Union]] and the former territories of the [[Terran Mercantile Community]] are annexed by the {{Imperium}}, moving its border adjacent to the [[Aslan Hierate]].
* [[604]]-[[622]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Civil War]].
* [[624]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Express Boat Network]] is established.
* [[704]]: the [[Solomani Autonomous Region]] is formed.
* [[800]]-[[820]]: the [[Psionics Suppressions]].
* [[871]]: the [[Solomani Confederation]] is founded.
* [[940]]: the [[Solomani Autonomous Region]] is dissolved.
* [[990]]-[[1002]]: the [[Solomani Rim War]].
* [[995]]-[[1065]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Second Survey]] includes data for the system.
* [[1065]]: the [[Second Survey]] is published. Information about the system becomes widely available.
